Project[orders.order_status AS order_status, orders.order_priority AS order_priority, order_count, total_revenue, avg_revenue]
  Filter[sum(orders.total_price) > 50000.0]
    Aggregate[group=orders.order_status, orders.order_priority, aggs=count(*) AS order_count, sum(orders.total_price) AS total_revenue, avg(orders.total_price) AS avg_revenue]
      Scan[orders]
